title: Join us for OpenAI’s first developer conference on November 6 in San Francisco
author: OpenAI / Modelverse Editorial
excerpt: Developer registration for in-person attendance will open in the coming weeks and developers everywhere will be able to livestream the keynote....
body:
Developer registration for in-person attendance will open in the coming weeks and developers everywhere will be able to livestream the keynote.

### Official Announcement
Read the full update directly from the official source at [OpenAI News](https://openai.com/index/announcing-openai-devday).

Stay tuned to [Modelverse](https://www.themodelverse.in) for real-time model analysis and benchmark coverage.
